notes.title: Map Fix
notes.content: Detectives, we’ve addressed a critical map-related issue in the mansion area. Previously, a portion of the floor in one section of the mansion was invisible, potentially disrupting your investigations. This issue has now been fully resolved, ensuring your journey remains seamless. Thank you for your keen eye and patience as we continue to enhance the experience!

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
We have released a small update to address specific issues in the game:

Workbench Issue: Fixed a bug that caused unexpected behavior.

Road Outside the House: The road was incorrectly elevated, causing visual and gameplay inconsistencies. This has been adjusted for better performance and smoother navigation.

Thank you for your patience and continued support! If you encounter any other problems, please let us know.
